The**minister of[public administration](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_administration)**(Italian:*ministro per la pubblica amministrazione*) in[Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italy)is one of the positions[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minister_for_Public_Administration_(Italy)#cite_note-1)in the[Italian government](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cabinet_of_Italy).

The current minister for public administration is[Paolo Zangrillo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paolo_Zangrillo), of[Forza Italia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forza_Italia_(2013)), who held the office since 22 October 2022 in the government of[Giorgia Meloni](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Giorgia_Meloni).
